name: @matthewye/opencode-toolbox
description: OpenCode plugin for autopilot development toolkit

scripts.build: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -r ../../skills/* skills/ 2>/dev/null; cp -r ../../upstream/skills/* skills/ 2>/dev/null; bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && mkdir -p agents && for f in ../../agents/*.md; do bun run ../../scripts/filter-agent.ts "$f" opencode "agents/$(basename "$f")"; done
